description: This Java class, AutowiredDeviceManagementAdapter, is a Spring Boot component that extends EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter. It injects a DeviceManagementService implementation via Spring's @Autowired and @Qualifier annotations, and provides it through an overridden method. Its purpose is to wire up the device management service with the event bus-based implementation, facilitating dependency injection and service configuration in a Spring Boot environment.

classes.name: AutowiredDeviceManagementAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that extends EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter, injecting a DeviceManagementService implementation via Spring's dependency injection.
